title: Health first
intro: Our breeding dogs are health tested, and every puppy is checked and prepared before going home. Ask us for the results of your litter's parents.

parentTests.title: Heart
parentTests.text: Cardiac evaluation, registered with OFA. Heart disease is the best-known health concern in Cavaliers, so this is a cornerstone of our program.

parentTests.title: Eyes
parentTests.text: Eye certification (CAER), registered with OFA, screening for inherited eye conditions.

parentTests.title: Knees, hips, and elbows
parentTests.text: Patellar luxation screening, plus hip and elbow evaluations.

parentTests.title: DNA testing
parentTests.text: Genetic tests for Episodic Falling Syndrome (EFS), Cavalier muscular dystrophy (CKCS-MD), and Dry Eye Curly Coat Syndrome.

puppyItems.title: Vet check and records
puppyItems.text: Examined by a veterinarian before going home, with full vet records.

puppyItems.title: Vaccinations and deworming
puppyItems.text: First round of vaccinations and deworming completed.

puppyItems.title: Microchip and AKC registration
puppyItems.text: Microchipped and eligible for AKC registration.

puppyItems.title: Starter kit
puppyItems.text: Food, treats, and toys, plus a blanket carrying the scent of mom and littermates to help with the first nights at home.

puppyItems.title: Sales contract
puppyItems.text: A written contract that requires spaying or neutering and includes a Return to Breeder clause, so a Brave Heart dog never ends up in a shelter.

raisedText: Puppies are handled every day and introduced to the experiences they will meet in a family home.
